# CSF v1 hand fixture

This directory is the independent, hand-authored golden package referenced by
`docs/coli-serving-format-v1.md`.

It deliberately is **not** generated by the future `.coli` compiler. The
fixture exists so the strict reader (#23) and compiler (#24) do not validate
only against bytes produced by the same implementation.

## Reconstruct

The binary files are stored as lowercase hex text so they remain reviewable in
git.

```sh
mkdir -p /tmp/csf-v1-tiny
xxd -r -p manifest.coli.hex > /tmp/csf-v1-tiny/manifest.coli
xxd -r -p data-00000.coli.hex > /tmp/csf-v1-tiny/data-00000.coli
```

Expected file identities:

```text
manifest.coli
  bytes   = 544
  sha256  = 8800cb6c1c27b04c0a6a9dfc41ee0ed6732f0cec88007d40acb7351563625f16

data-00000.coli
  bytes   = 4225
  sha256  = 2e4b5b89c8171f1cfafa89f9133f4df2090d122b6edb282e7c8d064eb25a09e9
```

## Logical contents

There is one required tensor record:

```text
record_id       = 1
name            = tiny.weight
kind            = TENSOR
codec           = NONE
math_format     = U8
scale_format    = NONE
layout          = CANONICAL
shape           = [1, 1]
logical bytes   = 2a
payload offset  = 4096 in shard 0
stored bytes    = 129 (128-byte tensor envelope + one data byte)
decoded bytes   = 1
```

The manifest source fingerprint flag is intentionally clear and the 32-byte
fingerprint is all zero. A hand fixture should not pretend to have been
produced from a canonical source-model inventory.

String IDs are:

```text
0  data-00000.coli
1  tiny.weight
2  portable-v1
3  hand-fixture
```

Manifest regions are:

```text
fixed header    [0,   256)
shard table     [256, 320)    1 * 64 bytes
record table    [320, 416)    1 * 96 bytes
string table    [416, 544)    4 * 16-byte descriptors + data + zero pad
metadata        absent
codec tables    absent
```

The data shard contains its 128-byte header, zero padding through byte 4095,
and the tensor record at byte 4096.

## CRC32C checks

CRC-32C is the Castagnoli CRC specified by the format document.

```text
logical tensor byte 2a                         = 0x1922f5b7
tensor record bytes [4096, 4225)               = 0x4a2d6a6e
data shard header [0,128), CRC field zeroed    = 0xcc6da2a7
whole manifest, manifest CRC field zeroed      = 0x30b2844d
```

For the self-containing CRCs, the corresponding four-byte CRC field is zero
while calculating the value and then replaced with the little-endian result.

## Compatibility rule

These exact bytes are part of the CSF major-version-1 parser contract. If a
future reader/writer change makes this fixture fail, determine whether the
change is a parser bug or a format-version change. Do **not** regenerate the
fixture merely to make a breaking change pass.
